column3: the audio stack and the frozen app libraries take

# Ai-Thinker ESP32-Audio-Kit: # most of the chip. Then 24 KB of ROMFS for compiled packages
# flash without loading into RAM (docs/guides/run-packages-from-romfs.md): the
# kit's drivers take 9 KB of it. The 96 KB filesystem after it holds boot.py
# The app slot grows into the ROMFS
# stays at 0x3E8000 and keeps its files when a new table is written. App
# partitions need only 4 KB alignment here (no secure boot).
